## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] If this changes cutout, recolor or upscale code: ran the CLI on a sample image and checked alpha and dimensions
- [ ] No secrets, private images or personal paths in the diff. Topaz stays optional
- [ ] The code matches the surrounding code (no new dependencies without discussion)
- [ ] User-visible change: added a line under `[Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior, CLI options, API fields or environment variables changed (README, `docs/`)
